name: NeoteAI
name_zh: 上海新智具身智能科技有限公司
summary: NeoteAI develops optical tactile sensors and tactile grippers for robot manipulation, alongside tactile data collection and embodied intelligence models. Its InTac hardware serves industrial grippers, dexterous hands and contact-rich robot control.
